description: §3.5/§7: skipped ticks, a crash after claiming, a server restart. Durable state, not the schedule, decides what is processed, and each canonical effect happens once.

steps.does: tick 1 claims work and the host crashes before acting
the lease expires after 150 s plus one renewal at most; the item is claimable again; the claim counts as one attempt under the existing queue rules, bounded by maxAttempts
ticks 2 and 3 are skipped by the scheduler; presence shows overdue only after cadence plus grace; no burst on return
tick 4 claims at most 3 items; a late reply for the tick-1 workRef is refused
the server restarts mid-run: leases, idempotency records and the notification ledger are durable; the retry of the same key returns the original result
